name: Mannitol
aliases: E421, mannitol, D-mannitol, mannite, manitol, mannitol by hydrogenation, mannitol by fermentation
what_is: A polyol, also called a sugar alcohol, used in foods as a sweetener, bulking agent, carrier, humectant and texture modifier.
why_botia: BOTIA flags it because E421 can replace part of the sweetness and bulk normally supplied by sugars and may also serve texture-related functions.
can_1: Identify E421, mannitol or D-mannitol when declared on the label.
can_2: Trigger the E-number, sweetener and texture information layers.
cannot_1: Determine the amount consumed from the ingredient list alone.
cannot_2: Predict an individual's digestive response or determine whether the mannitol was made by hydrogenation or fermentation unless declared.

sources.label: FDA — Aspartame and Other Sweeteners in Food
EU specifications for authorised food additives — Regulation (EU) No 231/2012
